C1038.title: Police Officer Convicted for Selling Personal Data, Judiciary Shows Zero Tolerance for Insider Threats
C1038.summary: In September 2025, it was reported that a post-90s police officer surnamed Li exploited his position to query citizens' personal information and sold it at 80 yuan per record, exporting data of nearly 5,000 people (including nearly 600 accommodation records) over nine months with 50,000 yuan in illegal profits. He was sentenced to one year and eight months in prison plus a 50,000 yuan fine for the crime of infringing on citizens' personal information. Earlier in 2024, several auxiliary police officers were also penalized for illegally querying and selling over 4,700 vehicle violation records, making illicit profits exceeding 70,000 yuan.
